title: Newhalo photo showcase
description: A full-bleed dark photo band with a big white heading (64 or 100px) and tall white cards with 8px corners: one card centred (an events notice), or a row of cards that runs off the right edge and slides one card at a time with two square orange arrow buttons. The photo drifts slowly as you scroll and the cards rise in.
